record.paper_title: Mathematical open problems in Projected Entangled Pair States
record.original_question: For a normal projected entangled pair state (PEPS) with bond dimension D, what is the exact best possible upper bound, in terms of D alone, for its injectivity index?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Fix a finite-dimensional Hilbert space $\mathbb{C}^d$ (physical space) and a bond dimension $D\in\mathbb{N}$. A projected entangled pair state (PEPS) tensor on the two-dimensional square lattice is a 5-index tensor $A\in\mathbb{C}^d\otimes(\mathbb{C}^D)^{\otimes 4}$, viewed as a linear map $A:(\mathbb{C}^D)^{\otimes 4}\to\mathbb{C}^d$ from four virtual indices to one physical index. Given a rectangular region $R$ of $m\times n$ sites, contracting the virtual indices of the tensors inside $R$ along their shared edges yields a linear map
$$\Gamma_R:(\mathbb{C}^D)^{\otimes \partial R}\longrightarrow (\mathbb{C}^d)^{\otimes (mn)}$$
from the boundary virtual indices of $R$ to the physical space on $R$.

A PEPS (built by translating one tensor $A$) is called normal if there exists a finite rectangular region $R$ such that $\Gamma_R$ is injective. The injectivity index of a normal PEPS is the smallest positive integer $L$ such that $\Gamma_R$ is injective for every rectangle $R$ of size at least $L\times L$.

Problem. Determine the exact best possible upper bound, depending only on the bond dimension $D$, for the injectivity index of a normal PEPS with bond dimension $D$. Equivalently, find the smallest function $f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ such that every normal PEPS with bond dimension $D$ has injectivity index at most $f(D)$, and exhibit normal PEPS attaining this bound.
artifact.status_search_result: Available literature confirms that a universal upper bound on the injectivity index of normal PEPS depending only on the bond dimension $D$ exists, but the exact (tight) form of this bound remains unknown. Recent works (e.g., the 2025 paper on computational complexity of injective PEPS and the 2017 generalization-of-injectivity paper) continue to treat the precise dependence on $D$ as unresolved, indicating the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: A generalization of the injectivity condition for Projected Entangled Pair States
status_evidence.snippet: For any normal tensor there exists L0 such that blocking L≥L0 tensors yields injectivity; a universal bound depending only on the bond dimension D is known to exist.
status_evidence.claim: A universal bound on the injectivity index in terms of D exists, but its sharp value is not pinned down.

status_evidence.title: Computational complexity of injective projected entangled pair states
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work studies quantitative injectivity in PEPS without resolving the exact best upper bound on the injectivity index in terms of bond dimension.
status_evidence.claim: Current literature still treats the precise dependence of the injectivity index on D as an open quantitative question.
